literal: Lord of the shore / fact of having forsaken / will they not proclaim / [question particle] / forearm / joint / slipping past / which are / bangles
translation: Will not these bangles, slipping past the joints of my forearms, proclaim the fact that the lord of the shore has forsaken me?
modern: என் முன்கையின் மூட்டுகளைத் தாண்டி நழுவி விழுகின்ற இந்த வளையல்கள், துறைவன் என்னைப் பிரிந்து சென்ற உண்மையை ஊருக்குத் தூற்றிச் சொல்லாதோ?
explanation: The speaker is suffering deeply from the pain of separation. As she pines for her lover, referred to as the lord of the shore, she loses weight, causing her bangles to slip past her wrists. She wonders if these slipping bangles will not publicly proclaim the secret that he has left her. The physical symptom of slipping bangles is a classic poetic convention illustrating the physical toll of sorrow.
